greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu kuni nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, usivele imfesane. Kristu, usivele imfesane. Nkosi, usivele imfesane.
psalm_response: Zinkulu, ziyamangalisa izenzo zakho, Nkosi Thixo uSomandla.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho ubona intaka incinane, isanda kuphuma kwindlu yayo, izama ukubhabha okokuqala. Iyamangaliswa, iyakwazi ukuba kukho umoya oza kuyiphakamisa, kodwa ikwaziva ukuba ihlabathi libanzi kwaye linzima. UBenjamin Vo wayenolu hlobo lomdla. Wayengumfana owayethanda iinqwelo-moya, owayephupha nge-'con chim airlines' yakhe, owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo eyayikwazi ukubona ngaphaya kwemida yeli hlabathi. Wayenalo lonke elo phupha, elo nqwelo-moya elincinci elalibhabha entliziyweni yakhe, lilungele ukunyuka liye phezulu. 

KwiNcwadi yeSityhilelo namhlanje, uYohane usibonisa umbono onamandla: 'Iyeza ixesha lokuvuna, kuba isivuno somhlaba sivuthiwe.' Ubona 'ulwandle lweglasi oludityaniswe nomlilo.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Ulwandle lweglasi. Yindawo yoxolo olungunaphakade, apho bonke aboyisileyo bemi khona, bebambe iiharp zikaThixo. UBen, ngoku, umi kulo lwandle. Akusekho zintlungu, akusekho mda, akusekho zifo. Umi phambi koThixo, elungele ukubhabha kulo moya wothando lwakhe olungapheliyo. 

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu uthetha ngesikhathi esinzima. Uthi: 'Baya kunibamba, banitshutshise, baninikele ezintolongweni.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Baya kunibamba. Ngaba wakha waziva ngolo hlobo? Xa intlungu ikubambile, xa usizi luthatha indawo yovuyo, uvakalelwa kukuba uvalelwe entolongweni yosizi. Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane mihlanu idlulileyo, ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, intliziyo yenu ikhumbula loo mzuzu xa uBen wayesemncumile, ehleka, kwaye esenza amaphupha akhe abe yinyani. Ndiyazi ukuba kukho amaxesha apho nibuzayo ukuba kutheni, kwaye kutheni ngoku. Kodwa namhlanje, ndifuna ukususa elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu. UBen akazange agule ngenxa yokuba kukho into eniyenzileyo okanye eningayenzanga. Akukho nto niyiphosileyo. Iziphithiphithi zeli hlabathi, izifo, kunye neentlungu, zizinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye uBen akakubeki icala. UBen wayenothando olungagungqiyo kuni, kwaye uthando lwakhe lusaqhubeka lukhanya. 

UYesu uthi: 'Akusayi kulahleka nalinye inwele entloko yenu.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Akusayi kulahleka nalinye inwele. Oku akuthethi ukuba asinakuphulukana nemizimba yethu. Kuthetha ukuba phambi kukaThixo, akukho nto ilahlekileyo. Yonke into oyithandayo, yonke into oyinikileyo, yonke into oyikhumbulayo ngoBen, igcinwe ngokupheleleyo. UBen akalahlekanga. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. 

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo nolwazi, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. 

Khumbula loo mzuzu xa uBen, eseneminyaka elishumi elinesihlanu, wathetha nabazali bakhe etsheho ukuba wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayesandula ukuhlaselwa zizifo ezimbini. Wayengazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, kwaye yayingafuneki ngenxa yokuba umalume wayene-insurance, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Le yimfihlelo yobomi: asikokuba unika malini, kodwa ukuba intliziyo yakho ikulungele na ukunika. UBen wayeyiqonda le nto. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukwabelana, owayethanda ukuhleka, owayethanda ukuba noRyan ecaleni kwakhe. Uthando lwakhe lwalungapheliyo, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhanya nangoku. 

Alan noThao, nina bafazi namadoda abathandayo uBen, nina Ryan, mfowethu kaBen, hlalani neli themba. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. UBen ngoku ungumntu okhululekileyo, ophilileyo, ojonge phezulu kuThixo ngoncumo olufanayo nolokuba wayesemncinci, xa wayesadlala neebhaluni zakhe phambi kwe-fireplace. 

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.

spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndikholelwa ukuba ukhona ngokwenene kwiSakramente eliNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenakukwamkela ngoku ngokwasemzimbeni, nceda uze kum ngokomoya entliziyweni yam. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ufikile, kwaye ndizimanye nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undiyeke ndahlukane nawe. Amen.
closing: Makube nani uxolo lukaThixo olungaphaya kokuqonda kwethu, ngoku naphakade. Amen.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Mna, Yohane, ndabona ezulwini umqondiso omnye, omkhulu nomangalisayo: iingelosi ezisixhenxe ezinezibetho ezisixhenxe zokugqibela, kuba ngazo umsindo kaThixo ufezekile. Ndabona into enjengolwandle lweglasi oludityaniswe nomlilo. Elwandle lweglasi babemi abo boyisileyo irhamncwa nomfanekiso walo nenani elibonisa igama lalo. Babephethe iiharp zikaThixo, kwaye bacula ingoma kaMoses, umkhonzi kaThixo, nengoma yeMvana: 'Zinkulu, ziyamangalisa izenzo zakho, Nkosi Thixo uSomandla. Zilungile, ziyinyaniso iindlela zakho, Kumkani weentlanga. Ngubani ongayi kukoyika, Nkosi, okanye azukise igama lakho? Kuba nguwe wedwa ongcwele. Zonke iintlanga ziya kuza zinqule phambi kwakho, kuba izenzo zakho zobulungisa zityhilakele.'

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wathi esixukwini: 'Baya kunibamba, banitshutshise, baninikele ezintolongweni, banise phambi kookumkani nabaongameli ngenxa yegama lam. Oku kuya kukhokelela ekunikeleni kwenu ubungqina. Khumbulani ukuba aninakuwulungiselela ukuzikhusela kwenu ngaphambili, kuba mna ndiya kuninika ubulumko bokuthetha obuya kuba nabachasi benu abangayi kukwazi ukumelana nabo okanye ukubaphikisa. Niya kunikelwa nakubazali, kubazalwana, kwizalamane nakubahlobo, kwaye abanye benu baya kubulawa. Niya kuthiywa ngabo bonke ngenxa yegama lam, kodwa akusayi kulahleka nalinye inwele entloko yenu. Ngokunyamezela kwenu niya kuzizuza iimphefumlo zenu.'

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
